entities.name: Mateo Albéniz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mateo Albéniz, also known as Mateo Antonio Pérez de Albéniz was a Spanish composer, theorist, and priest. He is not related to the better-known composer Isaac Albéniz, but he was the father of Pedro Albéniz. He is identified by the name Pedro Albéniz in some older biographical sources and was said to have died in 1821.
